name: ticketing-sla
description: Sistem Ticketing, Field Service, SLA Respond dan SLA Pengerjaan

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev -w @ticketing/api" "npm run dev -w @ticketing/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ticketing/contracts && npm run build -w @ticketing/api && npm run build -w @ticketing/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ticketing/api && npm run test -w @ticketing/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @ticketing/api && npm run lint -w @ticketing/web
